scope: Small manually reviewed discovery sample, not an exhaustive social-media archive

items.summary_en: The broadcaster attributes a daily count of ten Hormuz crossings to Kpler and reports the Minoan Dignity incident as occurring August 17.
items.status: secondary reporting; underlying traffic count not independently verified

items.summary_en: The channel attributes the Minoan Dignity attack to Iranian forces and makes additional claims about vessel disablement and unsuccessful evacuation attempts.
items.summary_kind: assistant paraphrase; claims require independent corroboration
items.status: unverified social-source claims; not merged into the official incident record

items.summary_en: The account claims that August 20 Sentinel-2 imagery shows AMARA near Larak. A matching-date Sentinel-2 scene covering Larak was independently located; the vessel identity has not been verified.
items.status: post-incident image interpretation lead; outside initial publication window, retained explicitly as later context
